name: Business Advantage Travel Rewards World Mastercard® Credit Card

localized_names.en: Business Advantage Travel Rewards World Mastercard® Credit Card

apr.notes: APR not available from page text; page uses dynamic placeholders (ProdStanMinRate% to ProdStanMaxRate% Variable APR). See Bank of America for current APR.

rewards.currency_label: Points (redeemable for statement credit toward travel and dining)

base_rate.description: 1.5 points for every $1 spent on everyday purchases

categories.label: Travel purchases at the Bank of America Travel Center

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for statement credit to offset travel and dining purchases. Redemptions start at 2,500 points. No blackout dates at the Bank of America Travel Center. Preferred Rewards for Business members earn up to 75% more rewards (25% Gold, 50% Platinum, 75% Platinum Honors).

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 online bonus points after you make at least $5,000 in purchases in the first 90 days of your account opening, which can be redeemed for a $500 statement credit towards travel or dining purchases.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: Enjoy no annual fee and no international transaction fees while earning points on all purchases.

benefits.title: No International Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No international transaction fees on purchases made outside the U.S.

benefits.title: Preferred Rewards for Business Bonus
benefits.description: Enroll in Preferred Rewards for Business for no fee and earn up to 75% more rewards. Gold tier (25%), Platinum tier (50%), Platinum Honors tier (75%) with qualifying BofA business checking account and combined balance thresholds.

benefits.title: Travel and Emergency Services
benefits.description: Travel services include auto rental coverage and $1 million in travel accident insurance, auto rental insurance, emergency ticket replacement, lost-luggage assistance and legal and medical referrals when away from home.

benefits.title: Employee Cards at No Additional Cost
benefits.description: Maintain a fleet of cards for your employees at no additional cost with ability to monitor all transactions.

benefits.title: Free Access to Business Credit Scores
benefits.description: View your Dun & Bradstreet business credit scores for free within Business Advantage 360.

notes: Business Advantage Travel Rewards World Mastercard. $0 annual fee, no international transaction fees. 3 points/$1 on travel at BofA Travel Center, 1.5 points/$1 on all other purchases. 50,000 bonus points after $5,000 in 90 days ($500 statement credit).
